maya: Heads up — a customer reported that the console's Effective access preview showed 'allowed' but the API returned 403 when calling /v1/generate. Repro: tenant=acme, role=editor, route restricts models to gpt-4-small only. Console preview only reads the entitlement graph, doesn't consider routing policies.

sam: Can you paste the API error / authz log?

maya: Error body from authz-service (sanitized):
```
{"code":403, "reason":"route_policy_mismatch", "message":"requested model not allowed by tenant routing policy"}
```
Authz logs show: `authz:deny route_policy_mismatch tenant=acme route_id=route-17 model=gpt-4-large`

jordan: Ugh — that's misleading for end users. Two options: 1) make preview explicitly aware of routing policies, or 2) surface a prominent warning in the UI that preview is only about roles/scopes. I lean toward (1) for correctness.

liam: +1 for correctness. We could extend the preview API to optionally run a route-policy evaluation and return a small object: `{route_allowed: bool, route_reason: string}`. Telemetry: emit `authz.preview_eval` with tags route_allowed=true/false and reason. Gate behind a feature flag (rbac_preview_full_eval) so we can canary.

sam: API change is fine if backward-compatible (field optional). Console team can opt in to the flag and render the extra pill. Need tests and perf check — calling route-policy-service for every preview may add latency. Consider async enrichment: show current preview then fetch route evaluation and patch UI when ready.

eng-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: authz-service v2 (preview-eval) deployed to canary prod-us-west at 1717000120 :rocket:

product-anna: UX note: If we add the extra evaluation, UI copy should be explicit: "Routing policy denies the selected model — the user will be blocked even if role allows it." Add a link to docs: "How routing policies interact with roles and quotas." Also consider a short help tooltip for enterprise admins.

jordan: Telemetry detail: emit metric `authz.preview_eval` with dims {tenant_id, role_id, route_id, route_allowed, reason}. For privacy, sample tenant_id for non-enterprise at 10%. Also emit an event `authz.preview_mismatch` when preview says allowed but route_allowed=false — this will drive alerts / UX triage.

liam: I'll open a PR in authz-service: add `preview_route_decision` optional field and metric emission. Default behavior unchanged. Flag `rbac_preview_full_eval` will flip on staging/canary. Will add bench that simulates 200k preview calls to check p95.

maya: OK action items: liam PR, sam coordinate console copy + async fetch pattern, jordan add metric to inference-dashboard (graph: preview_mismatch over time), product-anna to draft microcopy. Target: canary rollout (ff on) in 48h, monitor authz.preview_eval p95 latency and preview_mismatch rate. Full rollout after 1 week if no regressions. I'll open a ticket and link here.

product-anna: :thumbsup: thanks — please ping me when the draft copy is up.

sam: Noted. I'll also add a small QA checklist: verify fallback UX (preview says allowed -> API denies -> show inline banner linking to tenant routing UI).

maya: Thanks all, creating ticket now: https://rwd.atlassian.com/browse/INF-8421 (drafted).
